summary: This batch reports multiple severe collapses and partial collapses concentrated along the Bush, Pine, Stockton, and Financial District corridors (including 566 Bush, 513 Bush, 750 Bush, 670 Commercial, 447 Battery, and 27 Dashiell Hammett), with up to 36 people reported trapped across several sites. Debris has blocked alleys near Bush and Kearny (Claude Ln, St. George Alley), while 181 Fremont Tower and smaller residences on Grant Ave and Prescott Ct report minimal or no damage.
